# Fit Analysis

`sales.obj.icp_definition.fit_analysis` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability**

> One account measured against one version of the ICP, at one point in time, carrying the verdict, the evidence behind it, and how much of the profile was actually checked. The discriminator against the ICP object it is constantly confused with: the ICP is the instrument and this is the reading. Conflating them is why a definition gets rewritten every time a particular account is inconvenient — the argument belongs on the reading, which is allowed to be wrong, and not on the instrument, which has to stay stable long enough for being wrong to be detectable. The discriminator against a qualification verdict is what is being asked: qualification asks whether THIS purchase can happen, fit asks whether this ACCOUNT should be in our pipeline at all, and an account can be perfectly qualified and entirely wrong for us.


Also called: `Fit Assessment`, `Fit Score`, `ICP Match`

### Executable against the pipeline today

| Pattern | Kind | Reads | Yields | Statement | False positive |

| `fa.public_data_only` | deterministic | `deal.status = open` AND `absent: thread.last_inbound` | 9000 bp → `evidence_basis` | An open deal with no inbound contact of any kind — whatever score exists was computed from public data alone. |  |
| `fa.outcome_is_available_for_calibration` | deterministic | `deal.status != open` | 9500 bp → `evidence_basis` | The deal has left open status — this reading can now be scored against what actually happened. |  |
| `fa.value_below_the_economic_floor` | heuristic | `deal.status = open` AND `deal.value < 10000` | 7000 bp → `fit_verdict` | An open deal priced below the bottom of the target band — economic anti-fit, whatever the firmographics say. |  |
| `fa.enterprise_shape_with_smb_economics` | heuristic | `edge_count >= 3` AND `deal.value < 10000` | 7200 bp → `fit_verdict` | Three or more contacts on the deal, and a value below the band floor — the account buys like an enterprise and pays like an SMB. |  |
| `fa.stalls_the_way_out_of_profile_accounts_stall` | heuristic | `deal.status = open` AND `has_obs: objection_price` AND `has_obs: timeline_slip` AND `no_obs: budget_approved` | 6800 bp → `fit_verdict` | Open deal carrying a price objection and a timeline slip, with no budget ever approved — the signature of an account sized wrong for us. |  |
| `fa.displacement_against_a_settled_incumbent` | heuristic | `has_obs: competitor` AND `derived.momentum < 0.4` | 6000 bp | A competitor is present and momentum is falling — this is a displacement sale, which is a different profile from greenfield. |  |

## Constraints

- **`fa.disqualifier_is_absolute`** A hard disqualifier match cannot be outscored by anycombination of positive dimensions.
- **`fa.no_reading_without_version`** A reading must name the profile_version it was takenagainst, or it is not reproducible and cannot be calibrated.
- **`fa.stale_may_not_reject`** A stale reading may inform but may not disqualify.
- **`fa.no_self_widening`** This object may never alter the ICP it read. It may only raisea finding.
- **`fa.account_scope_only`** Fit is assessed against an account, never against a contactor a single deal.


## Business rules

- **`fa.disqualifier_overrides_score`** A disqualifier match sets fit_verdict to disqualified regardless of fit_score_bp. The override is not subtractive — a subtractive model lets four strong blocks outvote a hard blocker in the fifth, which is exactly the deal the instrument exists to refuse.

- **`fa.score_without_coverage_is_not_a_reading`** fit_score_bp may not be emitted without dimensions_unknown and confidence_bp alongside it. A bare number implies a completeness that sparse data does not have, and every downstream consumer will treat it as complete.

- **`fa.out_of_profile_deal_needs_an_exception`** Opening a deal against an out_of_profile or disqualified verdict requires exception_recorded with a reason. The exceptions are not the problem; unrecorded exceptions are, because they cannot be counted and therefore cannot become a finding.

- **`fa.stale_reading_may_not_gate`** A reading taken against a superseded profile_version may inform, but may not disqualify. Rejecting an account on a retired instrument is indefensible when the account asks why.

- **`fa.refuted_readings_must_reach_review`** A reading contradicted by its outcome is raised as a finding, never silently overwritten by the correct answer. Overwriting destroys the only training signal the profile gets.

- **`fa.no_widening_from_a_single_refutation`** One refuted reading changes the reading, not the profile. Layer 6 may propose a profile change; only a person merges one — Atlas Rule 06.

## Actions

- **Score the account** (system) —
- **Run the disqualifier list** (system) — Runs first. Cheapestcheck available and the only one that can end the assessment early.
- **Enrich the missing dimensions** (agent) — Targets theunknown dimensions specifically, rather than re-fetching what is already known.
- **Record an out-of-profile exception** (human) — Permitsthe deal and makes it countable. Exceptions are fine; uncounted exceptions are how a profile dies.
- **Refer the account to a partner** (human) — A disqualifiedaccount is often somebody else's ideal customer. Referring costs nothing, because we were not going to win it.
- **Score the reading against the outcome** (system) — Only runsonce deal_outcome leaves pending. Without it every pattern above stays uncalibrated forever.


## Evidence

- **crm** · 9000 bp — Closed-won, closed-lost and churn outcomes. The onlyevidence that validates a reading rather than producing one.
- **derived** · 6500 bp — Graph shape and momentum. Behavioural, live, andtoday the entire executable basis of this object.
- **email** · 6000 bp — Objection, slip and competitor observations. Circumstantialindividually, diagnostic in combination.
- **website** · 5500 bp — Public firmographics and tech stack. Cheap andcurrent, and not projected into a fact today.
- **manual_entry** · 4000 bp — A human's fit judgement. Fast, and the mostover-weighted input in practice — it is where confirmation bias enters the score.


## Metrics

- **verdict_coverage** (percent) — Share of open pipeline carrying a fit readingat all. The first number to look at, and usually the worst.
- **verdict_accuracy** (percent) — Readings later confirmed by outcome. Calibratesevery pattern above; without it the confidence_bp values are decoration.
- **mean_dimensions_unknown** (count) — Average unchecked dimensions per reading.Measures the enrichment gap directly.
- **exception_rate** (percent) — Deals worked against a negative verdict. Risingexception rate means the profile is wrong or ignored, and the two need different fixes.
- **refutation_rate** (percent) — Readings contradicted by outcome. The learningsignal.
- **time_to_verdict** (hours) — First touch to recorded verdict.


## Examples

- **Confident reading on nothing** — fit_score_bp 8600 from three of eleven dimensions,all firmographic. The number is real, the reading is not, and confidence_bp is the only field that says so.
- **Enterprise shape, SMB cheque** — Six contacts, security review under way, deal valuea fifth of the band floor. Everyone reads the engagement as health; it is cost to serve.
- **Disqualified with a high score** — Perfect firmographics and technographics, in a jurisdictionwe cannot legally serve. The override exists for exactly this row.
- **The classic misclassification** — An account marked out_of_profile because the DEALwas small. Fit belongs to the account; a small first deal at an ideal account is a land, not a mis-fit, and rejecting it forfeits the expansion the profile was built to find.
- **Refuted reading** — Scored out_of_profile, won, and retained thirty months. One rowis not permission to widen the profile — it is the first member of a candidate segment that now needs validating on its own.

## Metadata

owner **Sales** · updated 2026-08-08 · review **unreviewed** · confidence **provisional**


> Eleven patterns: five executable, six blocked. Every executable one reads deal behaviour — graph degree, value band, observation mix — and not one reads what the account IS, because no firmographic fact reaches the engine. The highest-value gap by a distance is account.industry / account.employee_count / account.geography as typed Layer 1 facts: three cheap enrichment fields that would unblock fa.disqualifier_matched and fa.resembles_the_churned_cohort, and with them the entire anti-fit half of ICP Definition, which can currently be authored and published and still never fire. Second is a retention signal (renewal_signed, account.retention_months): the profession validates a profile on retention, and the pipeline can watch every deal close without ever learning whether closing it was a good idea.
